# weir config

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Read or change settings.

```text
Read or change settings

Usage: weir config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list   Show every setting, its value and what it does
  get    Print a setting
  set    Change a setting
  unset  Put a setting back to its default

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir config set

Change a setting.

```text
Change a setting

Usage: weir config set [OPTIONS] <KEY> <VALUE>

Arguments:
  <KEY>


  <VALUE>


Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
```
